				<div class="elementor-widget-container">
									<h5 dir="ltr">2027 marks our 10th Anniversary in Brazil. A decade of unforgettable adventures, world-class kiting and lifelong friendships forged on some of the most remote and beautiful coastlines on the planet.</h5><h5 dir="ltr">Since our first trip in 2017, we have explored hundreds of kilometres of Brazil&#8217;s northeastern coast, discovering hidden lagoons, epic downwinders and spots most kiteboarders will never find on their own. This is our most special edition yet.</h5><h5 dir="ltr">Brazil&#8217;s northeastern coast consistently delivers ideal kiting conditions, with steady winds ranging from 20 to over 35 knots. That&#8217;s why we keep coming back, and why our guests do too.</h5>								</div>

<br><br>
We've done all the groundwork, carefully selecting the perfect kiting location each day, based on wind and tide conditions. You can expect steady winds ranging from 20 to over 35 knots, with most days delivering an ideal 25 knots—pure kiting bliss!</p></div></div>				</div>

srcset="https://www.kiterepublic.com.au/wp-content/uploads/2022/03/Brasil-KR-26-148-scaled.jpg 2048w, https://www.kiterepublic.com.au/wp-content/uploads/2022/03/Brasil-KR-26-148-300x200.jpg 300w, https://www.kiterepublic.com.au/wp-content/uploads/2022/03/Brasil-KR-26-148-1024x683.jpg 1024w, https://www.kiterepublic.com.au/wp-content/uploads/2022/03/Brasil-KR-26-148-768x512.jpg 768w, sizes="(max-width: 2048px) 100vw, 2048px"/></noscript>
</picture>
</figure><div class="elementor-image-box-content"><h3 class="elementor-image-box-title">A TYPICAL DAY…</h3><p class="elementor-image-box-description">Each morning, we'll wake up to the delightful sounds of nature and savor a Brazilian breakfast at our accommodation.
<br>
<br>
After carefully assessing the day's wind and tide conditions, we'll create a plan and walk you through it. Our daily activities will vary depending on our location and the best kiting spots available.
<br>
<br>
We aim to maximize our time with the wind every day, so you can look forward to a morning kiting session, followed by a delectable beachside lunch. Then, we'll wrap up the day with an extended afternoon kiting session.
<br>
<br>
On select days, we'll venture to different spots. In the morning, we might enjoy kiting at one location and then embark on a thrilling downwinder to a new spot for an exciting afternoon session.</p></div></div>				</div>
				</div>
					</div>
		</div>
					</div>
		</section>

						<div class="elementor-icon-box-content">
									<h3 class="elementor-icon-box-title">
						<span  >
							WHAT IS INCLUDED						</span>
					</h3>
									<p class="elementor-icon-box-description">
						<br>
<br>
14 nights of accommodations across 5 distinct locations, all on a twin-sharing basis.
<br>
<br>
Daily breakfast and lunches during beach days.
<br>
<br>
2x Special Dinners.
<br>
<br>
Bottled water, soft drinks, beers, and snacks during beach days.
<br>
<br>
Airport Pickup and drop-off (Only on the tour dates, other dates will incur an extra cost)
<br>
<br>
4x4 transportation for the entire duration of the tour
<br>
<br>
14 Days of Kiting adventures at different spots
<br>
<br>
Let us surprise you by relocating to new locations/accommodations every 2-3 days to maximize your experience!
<br>
<br>
10-30km downwinders
<br>
<br>
Flat water lagoons sessions
<br>
<br>
Support on and off the water for the downwinders
<br>
<br>
Skills clinics for maximum improvement will be run during the tour
<br>
<br>
Expect different breathtaking locations with flat water, small fun waves, river mouths, mangroves, and more!
<br>
<br>
We will visit small towns, where you will have the option to experience the nightlife or relax at the accommodation.
<br>
<br>
Visit to the iconic Jericoacoara town
<br>
<br>
We will cover hundreds of kilometers of the Brazilian coast throughout the whole journey.
<br>
<br>
Optional Add-on: Phil's Downwinder Special, 5 days pre-tour.					</p>

									<h3 class="elementor-icon-box-title">
						<span  >
							🏆 OPTIONAL EXTRA: PHIL'S DOWNWINDER SPECIAL						</span>
					</h3>
									<p class="elementor-icon-box-description">
						<br>
For those who want to go deeper, harder and further, we are offering an exclusive 5-day pre-tour Downwinder Challenge running in the days leading into the main safari departure.
<br>
<br>
Led by Phil, this is a fully dedicated downwinder experience designed for riders who want to push their limits on some of Brazil's most iconic stretches of coastline. Expect committed daily runs of 50 to 80km, remote landings and conditions that will take your downwinding to a whole new level.
<br>
<br>
This add-on runs in the 5 days before the main tour kicks off, so you can roll straight from the challenge into the full Brazil Kite Safari experience.
<br>
<br>
Limited spots available. Reach out to the KR team to register your interest.					</p>
